title: Chicken Pho Soup
description: A French twist on the classic Vietnamese Pho soup, featuring chicken, noodles, and herbs.

ingredients.name: fresh herbs
ingredients.notes: such as mint, basil, and cilantro

instructions: In a large stockpot, heat the ga over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion, garlic, and pho spice mix. Cook until the onion is softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the light soy sauce and stir to combine.
Add the rice noodles and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until they are slightly softened.
Slice the cooked chicken into thin strips and add to the pot.
Serve the soup hot, garnished with fresh herbs and bean sprouts.
Serve lime wedges on the side.
